delete_form_submission.label: Delete Form Submission
delete_form_submission.description: Deletes a completed submission by its ID.
delete_form_submission.afterResponse: return {success: true, message: `Submission with ID ${inputs.submissionId} has been successfully deleted.`};

delete_partial_form_submission.label: Delete Partial Form Submission
delete_partial_form_submission.description: Deletes a partial/in-progress submission by its ID.
delete_partial_form_submission.afterResponse: return {success: true, message: `Partial submission with ID ${inputs.partialSubmissionId} has been successfully deleted.`};

create_form_coupon.label: Create Form Coupon
create_form_coupon.description: Creates a new discount coupon to a specified form.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the coupon is enabled or not.

discountType.label: Discount Type
discountType.description: Choose between amount or percentage discount.

expiresAt.label: Expires At
expiresAt.description: The date and time when the coupon expires.

create_form_coupon.beforeRequest: const amount = Number(inputs.discountAmount), percentage = Number(inputs.discountPercentage); if (inputs.discountType === 'amount' && !(amount > 0)) throw new Error('Discount amount is required and must be ≥ 0 when discount type is amount'); if (inputs.discountType === 'percentage' && !(percentage > 0 && percentage <= 100)) throw new Error('Discount percentage is required and must be between 0 and 100 when discount type is percentage'); if (request.body.enabled === undefined) request.body.enabled = true; if (inputs.discountType !== 'amount') delete request.body.discountAmount; if (inputs.discountType !== 'percentage') delete request.body.discountPercentage; return request;

update_form_coupon.label: Update Form Coupon

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the coupon is enabled or not

discountType.label: Discount Type
discountType.description: Choose between amount or percentage discount.

expiresAt.label: Expires At
expiresAt.description: The date and time when the coupon expires.

update_form_coupon.beforeRequest: if (inputs.discountType === 'amount' && Number(inputs.discountAmount) < 0) throw new Error('Discount amount must be ≥ 0 when discount type is amount'); const percentage = Number(inputs.discountPercentage); if (inputs.discountType === 'percentage' && (percentage < 0 || percentage > 100)) throw new Error('Discount percentage must be between 0 and 100 when discount type is percentage'); if (inputs.discountType !== 'amount') delete request.body.discountAmount; if (inputs.discountType !== 'percentage') delete request.body.discountPercentage; return request;

delete_form_coupon.label: Delete Form Coupon
delete_form_coupon.description: Deletes a coupon from a form.
delete_form_coupon.afterResponse: return {success: true, message: `Coupon "${inputs.couponCode}" has been successfully deleted.`};

create_form_product.label: Create Form Product

imageWidth.label: Image Width
imageWidth.description: Width of the product image in pixels

imageHeight.label: Image Height
imageHeight.description: Height of the product image in pixels (optional)

create_form_product.beforeRequest: if (!(Number(inputs.price) > 0)) throw new Error('Product price is required and must be ≥ 0'); if (Number(inputs.quantity) < 0) throw new Error('Quantity must be ≥ 0'); if (Number(inputs.minimum) < 0) throw new Error('Minimum quantity must be ≥ 0'); if (Number(inputs.maximum) < 0) throw new Error('Maximum quantity must be ≥ 0'); if (inputs.minimum && inputs.maximum && Number(inputs.minimum) > Number(inputs.maximum)) throw new Error('Minimum quantity cannot be greater than maximum quantity'); if (inputs.imageUrl && !inputs.imageWidth) throw new Error('Provide Image Width.'); if (inputs.imageUrl && Number(inputs.imageWidth)) { const image = {url: inputs.imageUrl, width: Number(inputs.imageWidth)}; if (Number(inputs.imageHeight)) image.height = Number(inputs.imageHeight); request.body.images = [image]; } return request;

update_form_product.label: Update Form Product

imageWidth.label: Image Width
imageWidth.description: Width of the product image in pixels.

imageHeight.label: Image Height
imageHeight.description: Height of the product image in pixels (optional).

update_form_product.beforeRequest: if (Number(inputs.price) < 0) throw new Error('Product price must be ≥ 0'); if (Number(inputs.quantity) < 0) throw new Error('Quantity must be ≥ 0'); if (Number(inputs.minimum) < 0) throw new Error('Minimum quantity must be ≥ 0'); if (Number(inputs.maximum) < 0) throw new Error('Maximum quantity must be ≥ 0'); if (inputs.minimum && inputs.maximum && Number(inputs.minimum) > Number(inputs.maximum)) throw new Error('Minimum quantity cannot be greater than maximum quantity'); if (inputs.imageUrl && !inputs.imageWidth) throw new Error('Provide Image Width.'); if (inputs.imageUrl && Number(inputs.imageWidth)) { const image = {url: inputs.imageUrl, width: Number(inputs.imageWidth)}; if (Number(inputs.imageHeight)) image.height = Number(inputs.imageHeight); request.body.images = [image]; } return request;

delete_form_product.label: Delete Form Product
delete_form_product.afterResponse: return {success: true, message: `Product "${inputs.productSku}" has been successfully deleted.`};

find_form_product.label: Find Form Product
find_form_product.description: Finds a form product by name.

formId.label: Form
formId.description: Select the form to search products in

find_form_product.beforeRequest: const form = (text) => encodeURIComponent(String(text)).replace(/[!'()~]/g, (c) => '%' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()).replace(/%20/g, '+'); request.url = request.url + '?search=' + form(inputs.search) + '&limit=100'; return request;
find_form_product.afterResponse: const list = response.results.products; return {found: list.length > 0, data: list};

find_form.label: Find Form
find_form.beforeRequest: const form = (text) => encodeURIComponent(String(text)).replace(/[!'()~]/g, (c) => '%' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()).replace(/%20/g, '+'); request.url = request.url + '?search=' + form(inputs.search) + '&limit=100&sort=DESC'; return request;
find_form.afterResponse: const list = response.results.forms; return {found: list.length > 0, data: list};

find_space.label: Find Space
find_space.beforeRequest: const form = (text) => encodeURIComponent(String(text)).replace(/[!'()~]/g, (c) => '%' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()).replace(/%20/g, '+'); request.url = request.url + '?search=' + form(inputs.search) + '&limit=100&sort=DESC'; return request;
find_space.afterResponse: const list = response.results.spaces; return {found: list.length > 0, data: list};
